title: chemistry-framework: a configuration-driven framework for testing how molecular descriptors shape property models
description:
chemistry-framework is the analysis code accompanying the manuscript Evidence before prediction: a configuration-driven framework for testing how molecular descriptors shape property models. It implements (i) a training-partition feature-evidence scorecard for RDKit 2D descriptors, (ii) a rule-based recommender that maps scorecard evidence to a descriptor budget and a feature subset, (iii) a modular predictor that separates the physicochemical prior, the graph residual and their fusion, and (iv) the benchmark runners that produced every number, table and figure in the manuscript.

The archive contains the archived per-split results (benchmarks/results/) and the 20 Bemis-Murcko scaffold manifests per endpoint (benchmarks/splits/), so the reported statistics can be recomputed without retraining any model. benchmarks/paper_statistics.py regenerates all paired comparisons (Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled t intervals with Holm-Bonferroni multiplicity control), benchmarks/statistical_robustness.py adds exact sign-flip permutation tests and a Friedman/Nemenyi block test over the selectors, and benchmarks/run_random_control_study.py reproduces the 50-draw random-subset control. benchmarks/validate_paper_statistics.py recomputes 2,024 quantities from the archived per-split scores and checks the manuscript's numbers against them. reproduce.py wraps the whole sequence.

Scope: the release covers the manuscript benchmark only. The follow-up feature-space work (SIREN routing) is not part of this version.
notes: Replace the placeholder creator name and affiliation with the final author list of the manuscript before creating the Zenodo release. See RELEASE_NOTES.md for the release checklist.
